DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease) caused by Parvovirus B19.

The combination of recent viral prodrome (fever, rhinorrhea) followed by a pruritic rash on the trunk and extremities, specifically in the context of asking about the classic "slapped cheek" appearance which is pathognomonic for this condition, strongly points to Parvovirus B19 infection. While the rash can be pruritic, it is most distinctively associated with the facial rash and lacy reticular pattern on the body.
